about: The looks layer's proving case (2026-10-14): a turn-based artillery battle between teams of cartoon creatures on chunky destructible ground, with the aesthetic of a well-known 3D artillery game. This file holds no image and no name of that game. The target below is written from words alone (from: words, confidence 0.4), from the brief's 'what makes it read'; the look-target stream's target measured from the local reference frames replaces it when it lands (builder/look/target.mjs). The needs are what such a look asks the library for; `wave` is the pilot made with Meshy (library/COVERAGE.md).

target.words: candy-saturated cartoon: big-eyed creatures, chunky rounded ground with a visible soil cross-section, comic-book UI, oversized explosions, a bright sky

ui.style: comic panels with thick dark ink and drop shadows

vfx.style: oversized cartoon fireballs with dark smoke rings and flying debris

reads: candy-saturated colours under a bright sky
cartoon creatures with huge eyes and squashy bodies
chunky rounded ground with a visible layered soil cross-section
explosions far bigger than the creatures
avoid: the reference game's characters, names, logos or actual art

needs.words: weapon crate, supply crate, crate, health box
soil cross section, soil layers, strata

needs.code: a water surface shader (each runtime's own)
runtimes/three/kit/look/sky.js (a gradient dome; colours are look slots)
builder/ui/panels (CSS panels; ink and colours from the theme)
